title: Analyzing Toxicity in Open Source Software Communications Using Psycholinguistics and Moral Foundations Theory
reasoning: The paper's core methodology is based on Moral Foundations Theory (MFT). It evaluates how integrating five moral principles (care/harm, fairness/cheating, loyalty/betrayal, authority/subversion, and sanctity/degradation) as features into machine learning models affects the detection of toxicity in software engineering communications.
